summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (management information circular) for a special meeting on July 22, 2026, to approve a court-approved plan of arrangement under the Canada Business Corporations Act whereby Equinox Gold Corp. will acquire all outstanding Orla shares. The board, on a unanimous recommendation of a special committee, recommends voting FOR the resolution. The arrangement agreement was dated May 12, 2026. Specific financial terms (price per share, premium, consideration type) are not stated in this excerpt. Advisors include Laurel Hill Advisory Group. The deal is structured as a statutory arrangement requiring shareholder and court approval. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and regulatory clearance; risk-arb focuses on deal certainty and timeline.
